about: The world map (OpenAI image generation through Codex CLI): the region from above, without lettering; pins and routes in source/world-map.json. Original in ~/Documents/living-tabletop-world-art/.

map.prompt:
Generate one image and save it as moon-pearl--world-map.png in the current directory.

A world map for a tabletop role-playing campaign, landscape 3:2, seen straight from above like a hand-painted illustrated map (orthographic top-down view, no perspective, no horizon, no sky). A top-down illustrated storybook map of an underwater city on the floor of a deep ultramarine trench, seen through clear glass domes, luminous teal water and coral reefs outside. Pearl-ivory pavilions are joined by transparent dry gallery tubes, and an open canal curves inside the domes from the lower right towards the left. At the top centre, a bright workshop with a glowing furnace; in the upper left, a tall library with a huge round window; in the upper right, an oval stage ringed by eight coloured curtains beside a round pool, and at the far right a glass greenhouse against a great coral reef window. At the left edge, an old sunken stone building on a lower ledge with a staircase down to it. In the centre, a round stepped plaza under a circular sea window, and left of it a wide transparent tube corridor with a wave curling outside. On the right, awnings of patched sails and little footbridges over the canal. In the lower left, an enormous spiral nautilus shell pavilion with a terrace on the canal. At the bottom, a white museum with broad stairs and one glowing pearl, a stone quay under a glass arch with a lock gate at its far end, and a small covered boat moored there. No people, no lettering.

Draw every place described above as a small, clearly recognisable landmark exactly at its stated position, with the roads, paths, corridors or waterways between them visible, so that markers can later be pinned on each landmark. Fill the whole picture edge to edge with the mapped land (no border, no frame, no cartouche, no legend, no compass rose, no scale bar, no grid). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, labels or symbols that read as letters anywhere on the map. No people, no creatures, no figures.

The attached image is this campaign's cover: match its painting technique, palette, light and mood, but not its composition.

Original premium illustrated family fantasy adventure, tactile gouache and coloured-pencil storybook painting with subtle paper grain, elegant cinematic composition, intricate believable handcrafted details, expressive humane faces, deep ultramarine and luminous teal water, pearl ivory, coral peach and restrained warm gold. Wonder, gentle wit and visual depth; no horror, no graphic injuries, no franchise references. No text, no lettering, no watermark, no border. Every architectural interior is a stable dry air space with ordinary breathable air, the seawater visible outside transparent vaults; characters inside are not swimming.
